function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Here are some places you can order a cake from—whether you’re looking for a quick online delivery or a local bakery that can customize your order: | Type | Where to Order | What to Expect | |------|----------------|----------------| | **Online Delivery Platforms** | • **Amazon Fresh** – wide selection of pre‑made cakes from local bakeries.
• **Instacart** – shop at local grocery stores that offer cake delivery.
• **Uber Eats / DoorDash** – many local bakeries partner with these apps for quick delivery. | Fast delivery (often within 1–2 hrs). Great for last‑minute orders. | | **Specialty Cake Delivery Sites** | • **Etsy** – find handmade cakes from independent bakers worldwide.
• **Cake Delivery** (cakedelivery.com) – specializes in custom cakes delivered to your door.
• **Tart** – offers a curated list of artisanal bakeries with delivery options. | Custom designs, premium ingredients, often free shipping on orders over a certain amount. | | **Local Bakeries (with Online Ordering)** | • **Your local grocery chain’s bakery** (e.g., Kroger, Safeway, Publix).
• **Independent bakeries** in your city (search “best local bakery near me”).
• **Farmers’ markets** often have vendors who accept online orders. | You can usually pick a flavor, size, and sometimes add a custom message. Many offer pickup or delivery. | | **Specialty Dessert Shops** | • **Baker & Spice** – known for unique flavors and custom orders.
• **The Cake Shop** – offers a wide range of themed cakes (birthday, wedding, etc.). | Ideal for themed events or special occasions. | | **DIY Kits** | • **Amazon** – cake mix kits with frosting and decorations.
• **Home Depot / Lowe’s** – baking kits for kids or adults. | Great if you want to bake at home but still want a professional look. | ### Tips for Ordering 1. **Check Delivery Times** – Most platforms let you see estimated delivery windows. For events, order at least 24 hrs in advance. 2. **Read Reviews** – Look at recent customer photos and ratings to gauge quality. 3. **Ask About Customization** – If you need a specific design or dietary restriction (gluten‑free, vegan), confirm the baker can accommodate. 4. **Confirm Payment Options** – Some sites only accept credit cards; others also support PayPal or Apple Pay. 5. **Track Your Order** – Many delivery apps provide real‑time tracking so you know when the cake will arrive.
